I will keep this small beans plot the way I can manage with my own money and family work. The plot is very small, and as a woman I do not like tying cash down in a full fertilizer bag for beans, so I will use manure from home and save cash for the bigger plots. I will plant improved seed if I can get it in time because I can read the packet and I have seen other farmers get better stand with it, and I will spray a little when insects come because beans can suffer badly. This plot is rainfed, so I will not irrigate it, and most of the work I will do with family, with only a few hired days when work is heavy.
